technique_name: Synthesize an article on the potential pitfalls of relying too heavily on AI.
description: AI is becoming increasingly ubiquitous, with many industries relying heavily on the technology for various tasks. But the increasing dependence on AI, coupled with its current limitations, can lead to many potential pitfalls that can have significant economic and social implications. For example, reliance on AI may lead to slower decisions than those made by humans and can lead to unintended biases in decision making.
